evals.name: read-tool
evals.prompt: Publish exactly one Authors lookup as an MCP tool.
evals.expected_output: Explicit catalog entry for a one-shot query.

evals.name: unsafe-write
evals.prompt: Startup rejects an MCP write with read scope. Resolve it without widening unrelated access.
evals.expected_output: Require write scope or omit the tool.

evals.name: unlisted
evals.prompt: The tool list looks right. Prove clients cannot execute a hidden command.
evals.expected_output: Test invocation as well as listing.
assertions: Checks no write and a permitted read control.
